data.title: IREN (IREN) Swaps Bitcoin Rigs For Microsoft’s (MSFT) GPU Contracts
data.description: IREN (NASDAQ:IREN) spent years mining Bitcoin. On August 27, the company told investors that the chapter is closing for good. Fourth-quarter AI cloud revenue more than doubled to $70.5 million, and IREN now has $4 billion in contracted revenue booked against its 2026 capacity, with $1 billion of that already generating cash.
